newsitem.title: USA: YPF sells Medanito crude to Brazil for late Dec.
newsitem.headline: YPF sells Medanito crude to Brazil for late Dec.

text.p: Argentine YPF sold a cargo of Medanito crude to Brazilian state oil company Petrobras for late December, amid other Latin American spot activity, trade sources said Tuesday.
The cargo of 380,000 barrels was sold at less than January West Texas Intermediate minus $1.35 a barrel fob, the price at which it was last sold, traders said.
The cargo is to be delivered December 29-30.
Separately, Venezuelan state owned oil giant Petroleos de Venezuela (PdVSA) bought 380,000 barrels of Ecuadoran Oriente crude from a U.S. refiner for the first week of December.
PdVSA paid between $2.80 and $3 a barrel discount to WTI.
A PdVSA officials asserted that the crude purchase is part of a regular effort to supplement supplies to the country's extensive refining system.
Elsewhere, British Petroleum is offering a Cusiana cargo for late December, asking around February WTI plus 50-59 cents.
Colombian state Ecopetrol is offering a separate Cusiana cargo for January.
